line_items.reasoning: Q4 consolidated revenue came in at $14.1B vs. guidance of ~$14B, and FY2024 revenue hit $51.6B vs. the raised outlook of $51.5B — both slightly ahead of guidance.

Q4 adjusted EBITDA guidance was ~64% of revenue; VMware integration reached 70% operating margin exiting 2024 and infrastructure software hit 72-73% operating margin in Q4, indicating EBITDA margins exceeded the guided level, despite semiconductor gross margin compression from AI XPU mix.
Q4 AI revenue of $3.7B exceeded the guided >$3.5B, and FY2024 AI revenue of $12.2B surpassed the raised guidance of >$12B.
Q4 semiconductor revenue was ~$8.2B (broadly in line with the guided ~$8B) and infrastructure software revenue was ~$5.8B (close to the guided ~$6B), making both segments roughly on target.
The quarterly dividend was raised to $0.59/share — an 11% increase — well above the guided $0.53/share, representing a meaningful upside surprise on capital return.
